div.div:
Reading it
Every namespace inside the fenced frame starts from deny-all-ingress (Kyverno generates it for tier=app namespaces; identity carries a committed copy), so an arrow is the only way in. Not drawn, but allowed: the ten service namespaces reach identity :8080 for JWKS; pods inside product reach each other on :5432 / :6432 / :8000 and inside platform on :5432 / :8000; envoy-gateway and the service mesh reach the services on :8080 / :9090 (§ 3).

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1028px; height: 1px; padding-top: 675px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #475569;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#475569, #9ba7b8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Not fenced (yet)
No egress rules exist anywhere, so DNS and outbound traffic are open. mTLS on gRPC :9090 and a ClickHouse policy for :9000 / :8123 are planned follow-ups, not deployed.
